referenceMethod: Synthetic control. The nominal metre coordinates below are obtained from named construction features in make_fixture.py, using the prescribed map (x,y,z) -> (1+2z, 0.5+2y, 3-2x).
scaleBasis: This control prescribes a calibration of two authored metres per fixture unit. The fitted scale should recover it.
toleranceBasis: The generator specifies nominal decimal coordinates and the GLB stores them as float32. Allow one micrometre for this small numerical control.
